title: App is down - again!
text:
I was excited to find Busuu as an alternative to Duolingo, which has gotten increasingly more expensive and more obnoxious over the years.

Busuu is easy to use and engaging. However, at the price point, I should be available consistently. I don’t think I’ll renew my subscription.

title: Latest version doesn’t work
text: Latest version (11/4/2026) doesn’t open. Kinda mad because I pay for premium and I’m gonna lose a 1000+ day streak

title: Not better than doulingo
text: I bought the premium version without testing it out as much as I had should’ve but after about a month, it is just simply not as neat and feels like a rushed app on the design part. Another huge detail is that it is not at all beginner friendly and you are expected to already know quite a bit of whatever language youre learning.

title: More Ads than Language
text: I get some ads but this is more ads than actual learning. Some ads are also poorly formatted and impossible to close forcing you to restart app.

title: Great app but ads are irritating.
text: Great app but ads are irritating.

title: Better than Duolingo, but still room for improvement
text: It is more applicable and relevant for learning languages than Duolingo, but not enough speaking practice is integrated.

title: Реклама ужас!!
text: Приложение было хорошим до тех пор, пока чуть ли не от каждого действия появляется реклама. До и после урока, после входа, и тд. Само приложение хорошее, удобно учить язык. Но требовать подписку - заставляет меня покинуть данное предложение. Даже если бы я хотела, мой регион и устройство не позволяют это мне сделать и я вынуждена страдать, вместо того чтобы учиться. Если вам нравится смотреть кучу рекламы или есть возможность купить подписку- приложение вам подходит

title: Still no way to report errors
text: I would LOVE this app but there’s no way to report errors. So that occasionally I’m forced to give an incorrect answer because it won’t accept the correct answer. Other times, it asks questions but won’t accept full sentence as answers. Only sentence fragments. There’s no way to know what it expects from me: a complete sentence or a fragment. Today I was someplace too loud to do a verbal exercise but clicking on “I can’t speak right now,” didn’t get that exercise dismissed. In fact it wouldn’t let me finish the section without recording something.

title: Overall a good app
text:
Overall it's an ok app. 

The app does need some polishing though, in many ways. I've seen incorrect answers, lots of audio issues where recordings were made on cheap microphones with background noise, and varying sound levels, and lots of AI voices now. There are also a lot of UI bugs. I often have to force quit and reopen the app when some buttons become unresponsive. 

The app needs to be less pedantic. It's ok but I don't see myself using it a second year.

title: Unable to Cancel my Subscription
text: I want to cancel it but it is taking me to Apple settings. I tried your website it is also not helping me out.

title: Section test
text: I dislike that I cannot continue my learning for another 2 weeks if I fail a test at the end of the section. How does that promote advancement in learning ?

title: Ridiculous amount of ads
text: The amount of ads make this app completely unusable for me.

title: Non operational. Non responsive
text: After paying $54 for premium I am not able to move past 4 lessons. Subsequent seem to be only Premium Plus.  If this is the offer, beware! Several inquiries Ave gone unanswered or have been non responsive to the issue.
